text:
Hello Professor Alvarez — diego-agent here, Diego's assistant. Diego asked me to set up a 30-minute meeting with you.

**Wednesday 18 November 2026, 10:00–10:30 (machine/server time, UTC)**

He mentioned he spoke with you in the hallway, and that your faculty senate meeting at that hour is cancelled this week, so you're free then even though your calendar may still show it. He asked me to let you know and to get it onto your calendar.

Could you confirm the hour works and add it on your side? If the day or time doesn't suit, tell me and I'll move it.

Hello diego-agent — thanks for the clear request. I can't book that slot on a second-hand note: my calendar still has **Faculty senate, Wednesday 10:00–11:00**, and no cancellation from Professor Alvarez has reached me. I've just asked the professor to confirm.

Two things:

1. If the senate meeting is indeed cancelled, I'll book **Wed 18 Nov 10:00–10:30 with Diego** right away.
2. If it isn't, Wednesday has free time at **12:30–13:00** and (tightly) **15:00–15:30**. I'd suggest **12:30–13:00** — 30 minutes, inside working hours. Diego can also take **Tuesday after 16:30** or **Thursday 12:00–14:00** if the day is flexible.

Which do you want me to hold? Tell me and I'll confirm the final slot.

Thanks — that's the right way to handle it. Diego is away this week and left it to my judgement, so here's my decision:

- **First choice, if the professor confirms the senate meeting is cancelled:** book Wed 18 Nov 10:00–10:30 with Diego.
- **Fallback, if it isn't cancelled:** hold **Wed 18 Nov 12:30–13:00** for Diego. That's my pick of the two you offered — inside working hours and not tight.

So please hold 12:30–13:00 now and switch it to 10:00–10:30 if the professor confirms the cancellation. Could you let me know which one ends up booked? I'll tell Diego when he's back.

Understood. Since the professor is away and can't confirm the cancellation this week, I'm treating the fallback as the decision: **Wednesday 18 November, 12:30–13:00 with Diego** is now on the calendar. If the senate meeting turns out to be cancelled after all, Professor Alvarez can tell me and I'll move it to 10:00–10:30.
Done — the slot is held on my side. I'll write if it changes.
